title: detk module JSON document
description: Envelope written by de_toolkit.report.DetkModuleJSON for every tool invocation. The params object records the module's invocation parameters; the properties object carries the module-specific results consumed by the report views.

name.description: module name; lowercased DetkModule subclass name

id.description: content hash of (name, params, every input and output path as recorded, argv, detk version); stable across re-runs of an identical command, different for runs that differ in any file

schema_version.description: version of this envelope format, major.minor; this schema describes 1.2 and every 1.x document before it (1.1 added the optional in_file_paths and out_file_paths; 1.2 records workdir relative to the report directory, argv[0] as the command's name and every file path relative to workdir, where 1.0 and 1.1 wrote workdir and argv[0] absolute)

detk_version.description: de_toolkit version that wrote this document

last_modified.description: unix timestamp in milliseconds when this document was written

start_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC approximation of process start (module import time)

end_time.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the module was recorded

argv.description: process argument vector at recording time; argv[0] is the command's name only (e.g. detk-stats, since 1.2), the other arguments as typed, except that an absolute path, alone or as an option's value (--opt=/abs, -o/abs), is written relative to workdir (since 1.2); for detk-util record, the program of the recorded command (the first word after --), typed as an absolute path, is written as its bare name when PATH finds that same file by that name (/usr/bin/cp is cp), and relative to workdir otherwise

in_file_path.description: primary input file path, relative to workdir (since 1.2; a path typed as absolute too)

out_file_path.description: primary output file path, if any, relative to workdir (since 1.2)

in_file_paths.description: every input file path, in order, for a step with several (since 1.1; optional): written by detk-util record and by each command that reads or writes a file besides its primary input and output, left out otherwise; each relative to workdir (since 1.2); in_file_path is the first

out_file_paths.description: every output file path, in order, for a step with several (since 1.1; optional): written by detk-util record and by each command that reads or writes a file besides its primary input and output, left out otherwise; each relative to workdir (since 1.2); out_file_path is the first

column_data_path.description: column data (sample metadata) file path, if any, relative to workdir (since 1.2)

workdir.description: working directory of the invocation, relative to the report directory (since 1.2; .. for the default ./detk_report); 1.0 and 1.1 documents hold it absolute, which resolves the same way when joined to the report directory

params.description: module invocation parameters; empty only for modules that genuinely take none. A path among them is relative to workdir (since 1.2; detk-util record's command, argv, inputs and outputs), except that record's program, typed as an absolute path, is its bare name when PATH finds that same file by that name. A number that is missing or not finite (NaN, inf) is null: the document is strictly valid JSON, with no bare NaN or Infinity

properties.description: module-specific results used by the report views (a file path among them, as in detk-util record's checksums, relative to workdir since 1.2). A number that is missing or not finite (NaN, inf) is null, at any nesting level: the document is strictly valid JSON, with no bare NaN or Infinity
